input.description: 1-D or higher `Tensor` with last dimension at least `k`.

k.description: 0-D `Tensor` of type `int16`, `int32` or `int64`. Number of top element to look for along the last dimension (along each row for matrices).

sorted.description: If true the resulting `k` elements will be sorted by the values in descending order.

output.description: A tuple with two named fields: The `k` largest elements along each last dimensional slice. indices: The indices of `values` within the last dimension of `input`.
